caption:
बड़ी खबर आ गई है दोस्तों! 🎬
फिल्म OM Chapter 1 को लेकर जबरदस्त अपडेट सामने आया है। 🔥
इस एक्शन से भरपूर फिल्म में साई पल्लवी की एंट्री हो गई है। 🤩
वह फिल्म में Nithya Reddy का किरदार निभाएंगी। 💃
खास बात यह है कि वह इस बड़ी फिल्म में एक बहुत बड़े ऑपरेशन की कमान संभालेंगी। 🎯
इस दमदार एक्शन फिल्म में उनके साथ Dhanush और Mammootty भी नजर आने वाले हैं। 🌟
क्या आप इस शानदार जोड़ी को बड़े पर्दे पर देखने के लिए तैयार हैं? 🤔

ctx.title: OM Chapter 1: Sai Pallavi steps in as Nithya Reddy, taking on massive operation in Dhanush, Mammootty’s actioner
ctx.summary:
Dhanush and Mammootty’s Om Chapter 1: Udhiram – The Blood Wood is slated for a theatrical release on November 20, 2026. Directed by Rajkumar Periasamy, the film features Sai Pallavi in a pivotal role as officer Nithya Reddy. 
 OM Chapter 1: Sai Pallavi steps into the action world as Nithya Reddy 
 In a 1-minute-and-42-second glimpse from OM: Chapter 1,  Sai Pallavi  is introduced as Nithya Reddy, a daring officer who follows in her father’s footsteps. Tasked with tackling the illegal trade of valuable sandalwood, she names the operation OM as she sets out to preserve and protect nature. 
 Watch the glimpse here: 
 Om Chapter 1: Udhiram – The Blood Wood  is an action drama headlined by Dhanush. Apart from Mammootty and Sai Pallavi, the film also features Sreeleela and Naseeruddin Shah in pivotal roles. Sai Abhyankkar has composed the songs and background score, while the film is planned as the first instalment of a two-part franchise. 
 Initially scheduled for an October release, the film’s postponement was officially confirmed by Dhanush. The actor-producer stated that the decision was made to avoid a box-office clash with Jailer 2 and Suriya’s Scene, which is slated for release on November 6, 2026. 
 Dhanush and Sai Pallavi’s work front 
 Dhanush  is set to collaborate with director Tamizharasan Pachamuthu on an action entertainer tentatively titled D56. The film is expected to feature the actor in an intense avatar and is scheduled for release in summer 2027. Preity Mukundh
